comparison.objective: Balance a bar on a post and load both ends; candidate finishes four installed inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Centering, equilibrium maintenance, and sequential loading versus bimanual tool stabilization, regulated impact fracture, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Loaded bar remains balanced versus four tangs fracture into containment while inserts remain fixed and undamaged.
comparison.reason: Although both penalize destabilizing a retained object, equilibrium under added loads is not localized notch fracture. No spec versions or balance/load tolerances are available.
